game_concept: A action puzzle set in Mt. Pyre – Geyser Flats, erupting geyser flats: the lava scout must handle fire sprites while practicing data types & operators. Core idea – Exponent Engine: Use ** to power up engines: level 3 should deliver 2**3 energy.
theme: Mt. Pyre – Geyser Flats: erupting geyser flats
core_gameplay_loop: In Geyser Flats, repeat each round: Use ** to power up engines: level 3 should deliver 2**3 energy. Each round, a new ember crystals challenge appears; solve it to bank points before time drains. Then check the engine_power value and advance.
player_objective: Collect 130 points of ember crystals by answering each challenge with the right code concept before the clock runs out.
controls: Keyboard: arrow keys move the hero, SPACE performs the main action, ENTER runs the code.
lose_condition: Timer hits 0 with score < 130, or lives reach 0.
learning_alignment: Week 2 – Data Types & Operators | Level 1 (intro tier): Exponent Engine
assets_style: pixel-art volcano: purple-black rock, glowing lava rivers, orange ember light, drifting ash; flat Kenney-style sprites; low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Exponent Engine' (Week 2 slot 11), mission type 'Resource Rush', and setting 'Geyser Flats'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mt. Pyre
region.mood: low war drums, rumbling bass and crackling fire effects

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how engine_power changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against fire sprites in Geyser Flats.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: score >= 130 within 24 seconds.
